summary: Preserved candidate d8a3b79's single-rank parallel scheduler, deterministic assembly, CLI opt-out, distributed fallback, and SGLang construction lock, while correcting its reproduced native-library race. Native Transformers/Diffusers from_pretrained calls are serialized because their pinned implementations mutate process-global torch dtype and module-registration hooks and do not expose construction separately from checkpoint loading. Safe/customized component loads can still overlap. This fixes the concrete correctness defect but remains a partial implementation of the original feature request.

tests.what_was_measured: Transformers 5.12.1 local_torch_dtype contexts raced: float16 observed float64, float64 observed float32, and the process default ended at float16 rather than the original float32. Raw output: raw/native-dtype-before.txt.
After correction, each native load observed its requested dtype and the process default returned to float32. Raw output: raw/native-dtype-after.txt.
Focused scheduler, native isolation, CLI, failure, ordering, and loader compatibility coverage: 32 passed.
Extended compatibility: 68 passed and 9 subtests passed.
Synthetic parallel scheduler GPU outputs matched independent NumPy references: 1 passed. This does not validate Qwen-Image or native checkpoint semantics.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 ran the synthetic numerical regression against NumPy. No Qwen-Image weights were available.

remaining_limitations: Qwen-Image weights were unavailable, so the reported 63.20-second module-load bottleneck and launch-time reduction were not measured.

Native Transformers/Diffusers from_pretrained calls are serialized for correctness; realizing native construction/checkpoint overlap requires a library-specific split loader or upstream thread-safe scoped contexts.
Sleep/wake restoration and post-training refit paths are unchanged and untested.
Production checkpoint mappings remain pageable; pinned checkpoint loading is not implemented or validated.
Multi-rank component loading remains sequential because component initialization may contain rank collectives.
Peak host memory and storage pressure are not automatically bounded and were not measured with representative checkpoints.
No native C/C++/CUDA/HIP source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
